per_ac_findings.description: connection pool discipline: cycle runs without exhausting a small pool
per_ac_findings.test_name: test AC10: connection pool discipline multiple sequential run_cycle calls complete without connection exhaustion
per_ac_findings.B_tests_what_AC_says: YES — 5 sequential run_cycle calls complete, each returning an expected atom (no DBConnection.ConnectionError)
per_ac_findings.D_concrete_expected: YES — all results in enumerated expected-atom set

per_ac_findings.description: oldest_pending_age_seconds nil when no PENDING rows (not 0)
per_ac_findings.test_name: test AC14: oldest_pending_age_seconds is nil when correlation has no pending rows all-applied correlation produces no entry (nil, not 0, distinguishes from fresh row)
per_ac_findings.B_tests_what_AC_says: YES — `assert lag_info == nil or lag_info.oldest_pending_age_seconds == nil`
per_ac_findings.D_concrete_expected: YES — uses `== nil` (strict nil equality, not falsy)
per_ac_findings.nil_specifically_checked: YES — `== nil` used in both branches of the disjunction
per_ac_findings.discriminates_nil_vs_0: YES — if compute_all_lags returned an entry with oldest_pending_age_seconds: 0, lag_info would not be nil, and the second branch `0 == nil` would be false, causing the assertion to fail; the test correctly catches the wrong value
per_ac_findings.short_circuit_concern: NOTED but not a defect — in the all-applied scenario lag_info IS nil (correct behavior); the left branch firing proves the function excludes fully-applied correlations; if instead it returned an entry with :0, the left branch would not fire and the right branch would catch the bug

result.summary: All 16 testable ACs (AC1–AC16) have at least one test each. The 18 tests passed independently (exit 0, 23.9 s). Per-AC checks for existence, correctness of assertion, fixture isolation, concrete expected values, and exact edge-case coverage all pass. AC5 uses real Task.async concurrency. AC8 has exactly two tests with the strict-greater-than boundary explicitly proven. AC13 has two tests (lag=3 and lag=0). AC14 uses `== nil` strict equality; the disjunction correctly catches `oldest_pending_age_seconds: 0` if the function ever returns an entry for an all-applied correlation. AC15 asserts all three required payload fields. AC17/18 are covered by structural comment per instructions.
